glossentry.glossdef: A named, persistent chat room in . Talks can be public (visible to all users in the organization) or private (invite-only). All message history is retained.
A way to notify a specific user within a talk by prefixing their username with @. The mentioned user receives a notification regardless of their current activity status.
A private, one-on-one conversation between two users that is separate from any talk. Direct Messages support end-to-end encryption.
The visual speech-bubble element used to display a user's message in the Main Talk Screen. Each callout is color-coded to match the sending user's assigned color.
A sub-conversation attached to a specific message in a talk. Threads keep follow-up discussion organized without cluttering the main talk timeline.
An indicator that shows a user's current availability: Online, Away, Busy, or Offline. Users can set their status manually or let the application set it automatically based on activity.
A quick emoji response attached to a message, allowing users to acknowledge or respond to a message without sending a full reply.
An intermediary server that routes network traffic between and the cloud servers. Proxy settings can be configured in SettingsNetwork.
